label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: Classic DNS rebinding SSRF vulnerability. Hostname from user input flows to openUrlByHostname(host) at line 48. Although resolveHost() validates the resolved IP at line 46, the actual HTTP request uses the original hostname string, allowing DNS rebinding between validation and fetch. The resolved sink value at openUrlByHostname(host) is attacker-controlled (host = param from user input).

evidence.note: User param flows to host, DNS checked on resolved IP but fetch uses original hostname string enabling DNS rebinding SSRF
